overview.headline: Right triangle ratios define sine cosine and tangent for flight problems

keyPoints.point: A right triangle has one right angle and three sides whose ratios support flight calculations
keyPoints.quote: A right triangle is a three sided figure with one angle equal to 90 degrees.

keyPoints.point: the sine names the ratio of the opposite side to the hypotenuse in a right triangle
keyPoints.quote: We will call the ratio of the opposite side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse the sine and give it the symbol sin.

keyPoints.point: the cosine names the ratio of the adjacent side to the hypotenuse in a right triangle
keyPoints.quote: The ratio of the adjacent side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse is called the cosine and given the symbol cos.

keyPoints.point: the tangent names the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side in a triangle
keyPoints.quote: Finally, the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side is called the tangent and given the symbol tan.

keyTerms.gloss: three sided figure with one angle equal to right angle
keyTerms.quote: A right triangle is a three sided figure with one angle equal to 90 degrees.

keyTerms.gloss: side opposite the right angle and longest side of triangle
keyTerms.quote: We define the side of the triangle opposite from the right angle to be the hypotenuse.

keyTerms.gloss: ratio of opposite side to hypotenuse for a given angle
keyTerms.quote: We will call the ratio of the opposite side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse the sine and give it the symbol sin.

keyTerms.gloss: ratio of adjacent side to hypotenuse for a given angle
keyTerms.quote: The ratio of the adjacent side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse is called the cosine and given the symbol cos.

keyTerms.gloss: ratio of opposite side to adjacent side for a given angle
keyTerms.quote: Finally, the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side is called the tangent and given the symbol tan.
